title.narrative: Myanmar 2025 - HUM Localisation pilot: SDC/Meikswe Myanmar

description.narrative:
Sida and SDC in Myanmar have decided to co-finance a project by an non-governmental organisation. The overall objective of the project is that displacement-affected communities in Shan, Rakhine and Kayah states are better protected and become self-reliant through local community initiatives.
There are three outcomes: Outcome 1: Capacities of the Village committees and CSOs to design, implement and collaborate on community-centered projects are improved
Outcome 2: Conflict-affected communities, especially most vulnerable persons, feel safe and dignified, see their mental and physical wellbeing improved and empowered to find their own solutions
Outcome 3: Enhanced self-reliance of conflict-affected communities through vocational trainings, livelihoods and income generation opportunities
The project seeks to meet immediate humanitarian needs while strengthening the community-based system and the civil society, empowering local communities and CSOs to be resilient before, during, and after shocks.

Sida and SDC in Myanmar have decided to co­finance a project by an NGO called Meikswe Myanmar. The aim of this contribution is to provide direct support to a local organisation delivering humanitarian assistance and protection to affected people in Myanmar. The overall objective of the project is that displacement­-affected communities in Shan, Rakhine and Kayah states are better protected and become self-­reliant through local community initiatives.

Sida och SDC i Myanmar har beslutat att samfinansiera ett projekt av en icke-statlig organisation som heter Meikswe Myanmar. Syftet med detta bidrag är att ge direkt stöd till en lokal organisation som levererar humanitärt bistånd och skydd till drabbade människor i Myanmar. Det övergripande målet med projektet är att samhällen som drabbats av förflyttningar i Shan-, Rakhine- och Kayah-staterna får bättre skydd och blir mer självförsörjande genom initiativ från lokalsamhället.
